item.text: `policy.py` currently defines only the separator (`_`); it has no separate punctuation rule. The ingestion log and the task point to punctuation and whitespace acting as boundaries, so I’ll use that current separator for both and collapse repeated boundaries. I’ll keep the change limited to `archive.py` and the requested new test file.

Updated `archive_key` to lowercase titles and use `policy.CURRENT_SEPARATOR` between runs of words, treating spaces and Unicode punctuation as boundaries. Added regression tests in [test_policy.py](/private/var/folders/bw/5v8wl3ds53bds0kw2rx6bt_m0000gn/T/effect-bench-xrgwjeta/project/tests/test_policy.py).
